title: Wants an earlier window: books the later one and joins the waitlist
opening: Hi, I'm calling to book a repair, the AC runs but the air is warm.
callerBrief: You are Omar Patel, phone 512-555-0102, at 901 Brookside Ct, Kyle. Your Goodman AC runs but the air is warm. Give your name and phone when asked. You want a visit Monday 2026-10-19 or Tuesday 2026-10-20. When the agent says nothing is open then and offers a later window (Wednesday 2026-10-21), ask if anything earlier is possible. When told the earliest is the later window and the waitlist is offered, say: okay, do that, and book the slot. Accept the first Wednesday window offered. Then say that is all. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: No south-zone window is open on Monday 2026-10-19 or Tuesday 2026-10-20; the earliest is Wednesday 2026-10-21
The visit is booked for Wednesday 2026-10-21 with technician Jun Park, and the date and window are read back
The caller is put on the waitlist for an earlier window

dbChange.detail: One new hvac_repair appointment in the south zone on 2026-10-21: slot 115 (08:00-12:00, Jun Park) or slot 119 (13:00-17:00, Jun Park). One waitlist row in the app database holding a copy of the booked window; no other slot changes.
